Shared-note editors get the full editor.

### 🚀 Features
- People you share a note with as editors get the full toolbar, uploads and embeds.
- Code blocks are syntax-highlighted; **Ctrl+Enter** steps out of a block.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Syntax colours stay inside code blocks.
- The text cursor shows below the last line of coloured notes in dark mode.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.4.7...v0.4.8](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.4.7...v0.4.8)
